hints.title: Separate signed and geometric areas
hints.body: Use the given product-sign condition to determine the sign of the function on each side of zero. Name the positive geometric areas on the two halves.
hints.recap: A signed integral subtracts areas below the axis, while the integral of the modulus adds their magnitudes.
hints.pitfall: Dividing an inequality by a negative input reverses its direction.
hints.pause: Express both supplied integrals in terms of your two positive areas.

recall.reminder: A signed integral subtracts areas below the axis, while the integral of the modulus adds their magnitudes.

hints.title: Track the inputs in the requested integral
hints.body: Work out which original inputs are used by the inner absolute value over the requested interval. Relate the resulting graph piece to one of your named areas.
hints.recap: An input transformation may reflect one half of a graph into the other half.
hints.pitfall: The modulus is inside the function in the final integral, so it changes the input before f is evaluated.
hints.pause: Identify the requested area and solve your equations to calculate it.

recall.reminder: An input transformation may reflect one half of a graph into the other half.

solution:
Write L=−∫−20f(x)dx>0 and R= ∫02f(x)dx>0. The sign condition gives R−L=4 and R+L=8, hence R=6 and L=2.

On [−2, 0], f(|x|)=f(−x), so reflection (or the substitution u=−x) gives ∫−20f(|x|)dx = ∫02f(u)du =6.

Answer G: 6.
